LanguageData.RavenProj_BlackMistGrenade.label: (Raven) Black Mist Grenade
LanguageData.Raven_Weapon_BlackMistGrenade.label: (Raven) Black Mist Grenade
LanguageData.Raven_Weapon_BlackMistGrenade.descriptio: A smoke grenade filled with special alchemical gas. This black mist contains particles that can only be pierced by Raven Golden Crow bloodlines.\n\nEffect: Obscures enemies' vision and accuracy, but allied units are unaffected.
